Name: Gaming Toggles for PC
Description: Control Windows 11 gaming, Xbox, mouse, graphics and power settings from Stream Deck.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.game-mode.Name: Toggle Game Mode
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.game-mode.Tooltip: Turn Windows 11 Game Mode on or off.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.controller-game.Name: Controller opens Game Bar
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.controller-game.Tooltip: Allow or prevent the controller's Xbox button from opening Game Bar.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.xbox-mode.Name: Enter / exit Xbox Mode
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.xbox-mode.Tooltip: Send the official Win+F11 command to enter or exit the Windows Xbox full-screen experience.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.pointer-precisi.Name: Enhance pointer precision
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.pointer-precisi.Tooltip: Turn Enhance pointer precision on or off while preserving your mouse thresholds.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.power-plan.Name: Power plan A / B
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.power-plan.Tooltip: Switch between two existing Windows power plans selected in the Property Inspector.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.auto-hdr.Name: [Labs] Auto HDR
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.auto-hdr.Tooltip: Experimental: toggle the current-user Auto HDR preference. Windows or GPU updates may change this behavior.

com.maecly.gamingtoggles.windowed-optimi.Name: [Labs] Windowed game optimizations
com.maecly.gamingtoggles.windowed-optimi.Tooltip: Experimental: toggle Windows optimizations for windowed games for the current user.
